items.en: Auto Bild has rated the Lassa Revola summer tyre as “good” following an assessment of its wet and dry performance and ride comfort. Brisa, which produces Lassa tyres, says Revola is the first tyre in the brand’s range to be declared “Auto Bild Approved”.

Blackcircles.com has expanded its mobile tyre fitting operations across the UK, adding 13 new vans to deliver on-demand fitting directly to customers’ homes and workplaces. Building on established mobile services in Edinburgh and Glasgow, the expansion introduces dedicated coverage across 13 key urban locations: Birmingham, Brighton, Bristol, Coventry, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Leeds, Leicester, Liverpool, Manchester, Newcastle, Nottingham, Sheffield, and Southampton.

BM Catalysts, Europe’s leading manufacturer of aftermarket hot-end emissions products, has confirmed its participation at the upcoming AAG EXPO 2026, taking place from 5–6 November at the Exhibition Centre Liverpool.

The two-day event opens with a dedicated trading group members day, followed by a combined members and garage day. On stand 51, BM Catalysts will showcase its full range of emissions control solutions while offering insights into product coverage, technical developments, and distributor support.

On day two, the company will highlight BM Garage Pro, its free educational platform providing workshops and technicians with practical technical resources. Visitors can also participate in the returning ‘Spin the Wheel’ activation to win prizes.

Mark Blinston, commercial director at BM Catalysts, commented: “AAG EXPO is a valuable opportunity to meet members and garage professionals, showcase our product range and demonstrate the support available through BM Garage Pro. We are looking forward to two engaging days in Liverpool.”
The team will be on hand throughout the show to discuss aftermarket developments and technical support options for garage professionals.
